podDnsConfig.description: A Kubernetes PodDNSConfig (CGY-45509). Option values are strings: timeout "2", not 2.

enabled.description: FedRAMP profile switch. Selects the hardened value of every feature in templates/_fedramp.tpl.

dtmfSourceValidation.description: DTMF source validation of sbc-inbound and sbc-outbound while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides the per-service keys.

siprecRequireTls.description: Refuse SIPREC recordings to a non-TLS SRS URL on sbc-inbound and sbc-outbound while the FedRAMP profile is on (VG_SIPREC_REQUIRE_TLS). Overrides the per-service keys.

statsEnabled.description: StatsD (vg-stats-collector, telegraf :8125) while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides stats.enabled.

apiBanStrictRanges.description: vg-api-ban fails the run on a malformed API_BAN_BANNED_RANGES entry while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides apiBan.strictRanges.

apiBanMaxRedirects.description: Redirects vg-api-ban follows while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides apiBan.maxRedirects.

apiBanTimeoutMs.description: Timeout of each vg-api-ban request in milliseconds while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides apiBan.timeoutMs.

internalDtls.description: DTLS-SRTP on the rtpengine <-> FreeSWITCH media leg while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides internalDtls.enabled.

internalDtlsCiphers.description: OpenSSL cipher list of rtpengine's DTLS handshakes while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides rtpEngine.dtlsCiphers.

apiBanMaxBatches.description: Feed batches (250 addresses each) vg-api-ban reads while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides apiBan.maxBatches.

tlsKeylogLocked.description: Locks TLS keylog capture off on feature-server, feature-server-nightly and api-server while the FedRAMP profile is on (CSA-110113 / VDCL-SC13-001; SC-8(1), SC-13, SC-28(1)). vg-speech-utils' enableTlsKeylog() refuses to start while VG_TLS_KEYLOG_FEDRAMP_LOCKED is true.

requireExplicitEncryptionKeys.description: The daily billing job refuses vg-api-server's built-in billing signing key while the FedRAMP profile is on (KR-68; IA-5(7)), so billing.sendToCentral.privateKeySecret must mount a different key. Overrides billing.sendToCentral.requireExplicitEncryptionKeys.

apiSessionKeyDigest.description: Digest vg-api-server derives session-revocation Redis keys with while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides api.sessionKeyDigest.

apiStrictRegistrationHookValidation.description: Strict SSRF validation of registration_hook / queue_event_hook in vg-api-server (SSIP-AC4-001, AC-4) while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides api.strictRegistrationHookValidationEnabled.

registrationHookBasicAuthHttpsOnly.description: Refuse to send a registration hook's Basic-Auth credentials to a non-HTTPS URL on sbc-inbound and sbc-sip-sidecar (vg-digest-utils, CSA-102450 / DGUT-SC8-001, SC-8) while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides sbcInbound.registrationHookBasicAuthHttpsOnly and sbcSipSidecar.registrationHookBasicAuthHttpsOnly.

redisAuth.description: Password on redis-ha and a dedicated ACL user for update-api-ban-list while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides redisHa.vgAuth.enabled.

apiAuditLogTtlDays.description: Days vg-api-server keeps audit records while the FedRAMP profile is on (AU-11 requires at least 90). Overrides auditLogging.cleanup.ttlDays. Capped at 99999 so a values-file number cannot overflow on render.

serviceAuthFeatureServerV1Mode.description: SERVICE_AUTH_MODE of feature-server /v1 while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides serviceAuth.featureServerV1.mode. "off" fails the render; "report" is the incident deviation.

serviceAuthResolverMode.description: SERVICE_AUTH_MODE of resource-resolver while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides serviceAuth.resolver.mode. "off" fails the render; "report" is the incident deviation.

serviceAuthCallRouterMode.description: SERVICE_AUTH_MODE of sbc-call-router (drachtio's basic-auth credential, ADR-001 §2.8) while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides serviceAuth.callRouter.mode. "off" fails the render; "report" is the incident deviation.

passwordLogin.description: Password login on vg-api-server (VG_PASSWORD_LOGIN_ENABLED) while the FedRAMP profile is on (IA-2(1)). Overrides api.passwordLoginEnabled. Must be false: any other value fails the render.

adminApiKeys.description: Admin-scope API keys on vg-api-server (VG_ADMIN_API_KEYS_ENABLED) while the FedRAMP profile is on (IA-2(1)). Overrides api.adminApiKeysEnabled. Must be false: any other value fails the render.

bootstrapPrivilegedUsers.description: Bootstrap of the admin and cognigy-ai users (VG_BOOTSTRAP_PRIVILEGED_USERS) while the FedRAMP profile is on (IA-2(1)). Overrides api.bootstrapPrivilegedUsers. Must be false: any other value fails the render.

migratorFedrampMode.description: api-migrator FedRAMP mode (VG_MIGRATOR_FEDRAMP_MODE) while the FedRAMP profile is on (IA-2(1)). Overrides apiMigrator.fedrampMode. Must be true: any other value fails the render.

networkPolicyEnabled.description: Default-deny ingress+egress NetworkPolicy, per workload, while the FedRAMP profile is on (SC-7, AC-4; see docs/014-network-policy.md). Overrides each workload's own networkPolicy.enabled.

networkPolicyKubernetesApiCidr.description: CIDR of the Kubernetes API server endpoint. Required (render fails otherwise) when the FedRAMP profile is on and a workload needs direct Kubernetes API egress; empty string renders nothing. No chart default: the control-plane endpoint is environment-specific (AKS/EKS/STACKIT differ) and cannot be discovered at render time. See docs/014-network-policy.md.

ingressIpAllowListEnabled.description: IP allow-list (ipWhiteListMiddleware) on the 8 externally-exposed ingresses while the FedRAMP profile is on (SC-7). Overrides each ingress.<service>.ipWhiteListMiddleware.enabled. The render fails if the resulting sourceRange contains an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address, or a prefix shorter than /8 (IPv4) or /32 (IPv6); see docs/009-fedramp-profile.md.

sbcSipSidecarAlerts.description: sbc-sip-sidecar writes its alerts to InfluxDB (JAMBONES_TIME_SERIES_HOST) while the FedRAMP profile is on. With the profile off the sidecar always gets the variable.

sbcSipRuntimeRegbots.description: sbc-sip-sidecar regbots for carriers configured in Cognigy.AI (read from vg-resource-resolver) while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides sbcSipSidecar.runtimeRegbots.enabled.

redisTls.description: TLS listeners on redis-ha, which require a client certificate, and TLS with a chart-signed client certificate from the host-network clients (sbc-sip-sidecar and drachtio in the sbc-sip pod) while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides redisHa.vgTls.enabled and redisHa.vgTls.clients.*. Needs redisHa, Sentinel mode, an sbc-sip-sidecar image with vg-redis 2.0.34 or later and vg-drachtio 1.3.23 or later.

mysqlTls.description: MySQL serves the chart-minted certificate and the host-network clients (sbc-sip-sidecar, the sbc-sip init container) require TLS to it while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides mysql.vgTls.enabled and mysql.vgTls.clients.*. Needs the in-cluster MySQL.

callRouterTls.description: sbc-call-router serves HTTPS with the chart-minted certificate and sbc-sip's drachtio verifies it while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides sbcCallRouter.tls.enabled.

drachtioControlTls.description: mTLS with chart-minted certificates on the drachtio control hop (sbc-sip's drachtio to sbc-inbound and sbc-outbound), on sbc-sip, sbc-inbound, sbc-outbound and sbc-call-router at once, while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides drachtioControlTls.enabled. Needs drachtio, SBC and call-router images at or above drachtioControlTls.drachtioMinVersion and drachtioControlTls.minImageVersions.

dtmfSourceValidation.description: DTMF source validation of vg-rtpengine-utils. null renders nothing (library default). Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

registrationHookBasicAuthHttpsOnly.description: CSA-102450: renders FEATURE_REGISTRATION_HOOK_BASIC_AUTH_HTTPS_ONLY_ENABLED on sbc-inbound. true refuses a registration hook's Basic-Auth credentials on a non-HTTPS URL (device INVITE fails with 500). null renders nothing (vg-digest-utils default: not refused). Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

siprecRequireTls.description: Refuse SIPREC recordings to a non-TLS SRS URL (VG_SIPREC_REQUIRE_TLS of vg-siprec-client-utils). null renders nothing (library default: off). Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

registrationHookBasicAuthHttpsOnly.description: CSA-102450: renders FEATURE_REGISTRATION_HOOK_BASIC_AUTH_HTTPS_ONLY_ENABLED on sbc-sip-sidecar. true refuses a registration hook's Basic-Auth credentials on a non-HTTPS URL (REGISTER fails with 500). null renders nothing (vg-digest-utils default: not refused). Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

enabled.description: DTLS-SRTP on the rtpengine <-> FreeSWITCH media leg. Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

dtlsCiphers.description: OpenSSL cipher list of rtpengine's DTLS handshakes (--dtls-ciphers) while global.fedramp.enabled is false. Empty keeps rtpengine's default. Only cipher-string characters: the STACKIT shell script renders it in double quotes, where $ and backticks would expand.

dtmfSourceValidation.description: DTMF source validation of vg-rtpengine-utils. null renders nothing (library default). Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

siprecRequireTls.description: Refuse SIPREC recordings to a non-TLS SRS URL (VG_SIPREC_REQUIRE_TLS of vg-siprec-client-utils). null renders nothing (library default: off). Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

strictRanges.description: vg-api-ban fails the run on a malformed API_BAN_BANNED_RANGES entry. false logs and skips it. Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

maxRedirects.description: Redirects vg-api-ban follows. Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout of each vg-api-ban request in milliseconds. Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

maxBatches.description: Feed batches (250 addresses each) vg-api-ban reads. Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod securityContext of the update-api-ban-list CronJob. null removes it.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext of the update-api-ban-list CronJob. readOnlyRootFilesystem: true also mounts an emptyDir at /tmp. null removes it.

enabled.description: Render the update-api-ban-list NetworkPolicy. Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

requireExplicitEncryptionKeys.description: KR-68 / CSA-103928: renders REQUIRE_EXPLICIT_ENCRYPTION_KEYS on the daily-billing-reporting CronJob; true makes vg-api-server refuse its built-in billing signing key. Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on (global.fedramp.requireExplicitEncryptionKeys applies). null leaves the variable unset.

allowPrivateCustomUrls.description: TEST-ONLY: renders api-server's ALLOW_PRIVATE_CUSTOM_URLS SSRF escape hatch. Must never be enabled on production values. null (default) follows vgTestHarness.enabled; explicit true/false overrides.

strictRegistrationHookValidationEnabled.description: CSA-102746 / SSIP-AC4-001: renders api-server's FEATURE_STRICT_REGISTRATION_HOOK_VALIDATION_ENABLED, gating the registration_hook/queue_event_hook SSRF guard (guardHookUrl / rejectPrivateHost) at save time only; the dial-time check in vg-digest-utils is not wired by this chart yet. Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on (global.fedramp.apiStrictRegistrationHookValidation applies). null leaves the variable unset and vg-api-server keeps its own default.

sessionKeyDigest.description: Digest used to derive session-revocation Redis keys. Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on. null leaves the variable unset and vg-api-server keeps its default, md5. Changing this on a populated cluster relocates every stored session and needs a scale-to-zero cutover through api.replicaCount - see Cognigy/vg-api-server docs/fedramp-remediation-1-upgrade.md.

passwordLoginEnabled.description: VG_PASSWORD_LOGIN_ENABLED. Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on. null leaves it unset (password login stays on).

adminApiKeysEnabled.description: VG_ADMIN_API_KEYS_ENABLED. Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on. null leaves it unset (admin-scope keys stay accepted).

bootstrapPrivilegedUsers.description: VG_BOOTSTRAP_PRIVILEGED_USERS. Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on. null leaves it unset (the admin and cognigy-ai users are bootstrapped).

ttlDays.description: Days vg-api-server keeps audit records (AUDIT_LOG_TTL_DAYS). Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on. A whole number from 1 to 99999, as a number or a quoted string of digits; null leaves the variable unset. Zero, negative and non-numeric values are refused: vg-api-server images before #255 read a negative value as a window in the future and delete every audit record.

agenticEndpoint.description: Fallback for feature-server's dial-time agent routing only, used for an agent-targeted application that predates vg-api-server's per-application agentic_endpoint_hook column. vg-api-server itself no longer reads this.

pathPrefix.description: Path appended to the derived host. Must match vg-agentic-endpoint's ingress routePrefix + wsPath.

baseUrl.description: Host override for when the adapter isn't on the API host, same syntax as cognigyLogin.baseUrl (an http(s) URL, not a websocket one) — e.g. https://api-dev.cognigy.ai, no path. The scheme is normalized to ws(s):// and pathPrefix is appended automatically. Empty derives the host from cognigyLogin.baseUrl.

speechInterception.description: Whether the harness intercepts real speech-vendor traffic. 'none' (default) redirects nothing at the infrastructure level -- a custom:<name> credential still reaches mock-speech by the URL stored on the credential, needing nothing from this chart. 'vendor' makes VG dial the real vendor hostnames and rewrites them, in-namespace, to mock-speech's TLS listener -- deriving regionDns and its rewrite list, mockSpeech.tls and its certificate, the FreeSWITCH and api-server dnsConfig, and the CA-trust overlay.

numbers.description: Numbers the provisioner creates in VG MySQL (manifest mode). number must be a quoted string: an unquoted YAML number decodes as a float, which neither the provisioner nor the mock-runtime-api overlap guard can compare reliably.

organisations.description: Organisations that exist ONLY in the Cognigy.AI cluster, served by mock-runtime-api (CGY-38776). Their numbers must not also be provisioned into VG MySQL.

generate.description: Whether the chart mints mock-speech's CA and leaf itself (default true), reusing the existing Secret on upgrade so the CA is stable. Applies on the vendor route only: speechInterception=vendor derives the hostname list the leaf must cover. With mockSpeech.tls.enabled alone the Secret must be supplied from outside. Set false where a run mints its own and needs the CA outside the cluster.

caConfigMapName.description: ConfigMap holding the CA that signed mock-speech's leaf, mounted by the CA-trust overlay the chart renders on the vendor route. The chart creates it alongside the Secret when generate is true; with generate false it must exist before install.

speechVendor.description: Which vendor the provision Job points every provisioned application at. Every vendor is served simultaneously; this only selects what gets provisioned.

mockDeepgramRegion.description: DEPRECATED: superseded by the speech adapter (regionDns.rewrites -> mock-speech plus mockSpeech.tls). Kept so a namespace with its own rewrites still validates; the image pin is frozen because vg-test-harness deleted the binary.

rewrites.description: Hostnames test-dns answers for, and the in-namespace Service each resolves to. Point these at mock-speech for the speech adapter.

clusterIPBase.description: Dotted prefix, e.g. "172.20.0", that test-dns's ClusterIP is derived from when clusterIP is unset -- the last octet comes from the namespace name. Normally left empty: the chart defaults the prefix to kube-system/kube-dns's own /24, which Kubernetes reserves for pinned addresses and never allocates from dynamically. Set it only to override that choice.

carrierDefaultApplication.description: Whether the test carrier keeps a fallback application (default true). false only for the kindvgai suite (CGY-38776), whose legacy-miss fallback hangs off the no_gateway rejection this pin prevents.

signingKeySecret.description: Test-only: Secret whose active private key the vg-test-harness runner signs service-auth test requests with (the internal key). Empty renders nothing.

fedrampMode.description: VG_MIGRATOR_FEDRAMP_MODE. Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on. null leaves it unset (today's seed and admin user).

serviceAuth.description: Signed service-to-service auth (vg-resources ADR-001). Wiring: templates/_service-auth.tpl.

autoGenerate.description: Render the hook Job that creates the vg-service-key-* Secrets. Independent of vgCluster.signingKey.

generatorImage.description: Image of the key Job (bash, openssl, kubectl). Empty: vgCluster.signingKey.generatorImage. Use a FIPS-capable image for FedRAMP.

active.description: Slot the caller signs with. Must be listed in slots.

slots.description: Slots the key Job makes sure exist; it adds a missing one and never touches an existing one.

active.description: Slot the caller signs with. Must be listed in slots.

mode.description: SERVICE_AUTH_MODE outside FedRAMP. null: the default from the readiness marker (report in this release). Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on.
SERVICE_AUTH_MODE outside FedRAMP. null: the default from the readiness marker (report in this release). Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on.
SERVICE_AUTH_MODE of sbc-call-router (drachtio's basic-auth credential) outside FedRAMP. null: report in this release. Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on.

autoGenerate.description: Create Secret vg-call-router-credentials with a hook Job. false: provide it yourself.

opsMinter.description: Ops minter (CGY-43874, ADR-001 §2.3): a pod holding only the ops private key; members of execGroup exec into it to mint vg-ops tokens. Templates: templates/ops-minter/.

execGroup.description: Kubernetes group allowed to exec into vg-ops-minter-0. Required when enabled.

enabled.description: Default-deny ingress and egress for vg-ops-minter. Under the FedRAMP profile it follows global.fedramp.networkPolicyEnabled and this value is ignored.
Password on redis-ha and a dedicated ACL user for update-api-ban-list. Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on (global.fedramp.redisAuth applies).

vgTls.description: TLS listeners on redis-ha for the host-network clients (docs/011-redis-tls.md). Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on (global.fedramp.redisTls applies).

enabled.description: TLS listeners on redis-ha that require a client certificate, and the three certificate Secrets (CA, server, sbc-sip client).

sbcSipSidecar.description: sbc-sip-sidecar connects over TLS with its client certificate (needs an image whose vg-redis has REDIS_TLS_CERT_FILE, Cognigy/vg-redis#52).

drachtio.description: drachtio in sbc-sip reads its ban lists over TLS (CGY-45825).

drachtioMinVersion.description: First vg-drachtio release with --blacklist-redis-tls; an older semver drachtio.image is refused while the drachtio client is on.

tls.description: HTTPS on sbcCallRouter.port with a chart-minted certificate, verified by sbc-sip's drachtio (docs/016-call-router-tls.md). Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on (global.fedramp.callRouterTls applies).

enabled.description: sbc-call-router serves HTTPS only, and drachtio posts INVITEs over TLS.

drachtioMinVersion.description: Oldest vg-drachtio release that carries the request-handler ca-file attribute; an older release tag in drachtio.image fails the render while TLS is on. Empty switches the check off.

minVersion.description: Oldest vg-sbc-call-router release (preview suffix included) that serves HTTPS; an older release tag in sbcCallRouter.image fails the render while TLS is on. Empty switches the check off.

drachtioControlTls.description: TLS on the drachtio control hop (docs/017-drachtio-control-tls.md). While the FedRAMP profile is on, enabled is ignored (global.fedramp.drachtioControlTls applies); the other keys still apply, and with the hop on the profile requires drachtioMinVersion and all three minImageVersions.

enabled.description: sbc-sip's drachtio dials sbc-inbound and sbc-outbound over mTLS, and sbc-call-router routes to them with ;transport=tls.

prepare.description: Mint and mount the certificates without switching the hop (cutover step 1). Applies under the FedRAMP profile too.

drachtioMinVersion.description: First vg-drachtio release with DRACHTIO_OUTBOUND_TLS_CA_FILE (X.Y.Z, checked on every render); an older drachtio.image is refused while the hop is on. Empty disables the check, except under the FedRAMP profile with the hop on, where it is refused.

minImageVersions.description: First sbc-inbound, sbc-outbound and sbc-call-router releases with CGY-46071 (YYYY.N.P, YYYY.N.P-<number> or YYYY.N.P-rc<number>); an older image is refused while the hop is on. Empty leaves the image unchecked, which the FedRAMP profile refuses while the hop is on.

allowUncheckedImages.description: Under the FedRAMP profile with the hop on, let images whose tag cannot be checked pass (a POA&M deviation). No effect outside the profile.

vgTls.description: Chart-minted certificate on MySQL for the host-network clients (docs/012-mysql-tls.md). Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on (global.fedramp.mysqlTls applies).

enabled.description: MySQL serves the chart's certificate, and the certificate Secret.

sbcSipSidecar.description: The sbc-sip pod (sbc-sip-sidecar and the db-create-wait init container) requires TLS to MySQL.
